title_sq: Super mundesi investimi 3 Garsoniere ne shitje tek Mine Peza ne Tirane
description_sq:
Mine Peza perballe Golden Tower Shiten 3 Garsoniere+lavanteri te investuara ne detaje te pershtatuara per AirBnb me siperfaqe 84m2, kati 4 pallat 6 katesh. Garsonieret jane te investuara nga e para duke filluar nga instalime elektrike, hidraulike (multistrat), dyer, dritare triple xham plastike, tavane te varura etj. Shiten te mobiluar si ne foto. Mundesi e art investimi duke marre parasysh se aktualisht jane te dhena me qera 1400 Euro neto me kontrat noteriale per 3 vite.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Shitet 255 000 Euro
title_en: Super investment opportunity, 3 studios for sale in Mine Peza in Tirana
description_en: Mine Peza in front of Golden Tower For sale 3 studios + laundry, invested in details adapted for AirBnb with surface area of ​​84m2, 4th floor of a 6-storey building. The studios are invested from scratch, starting with electrical, plumbing (multilayer), doors, triple-glazed plastic windows, suspended ceilings, etc. Sold furnished as in the photo. An investment opportunity, considering that they are currently rented for 1400 Euro net with a notarial contract for 3 years. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For sale 255 000 Euro
